drafted_from: tool:blur-faces-not-agreed-in-a-picture's row in tools/media-composition/records.json, and the --picture mode of tools/media-composition/do-work/blur-faces-not-agreed.py (the same script as the video copy, picture in and picture out)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Blur everyone in this picture who has not agreed." It runs tool:blur-faces-not-agreed-in-a-picture and keeps the copy in your files.
no_lists_because: It reads the picture and the agreed pictures you name and keeps one copy of the picture, so it keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find the picture's identity in your files, and a clear picture of each person who agreed to be shown (yourself included).
2. Say "Blur everyone in this picture who has not agreed" with picture and agreed. With no agreed pictures every face is blurred.
3. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run and tool tool:blur-faces-not-agreed-in-a-picture. It runs on the tool's own computer with no network.
4. Read result: faces, blurred, kept, agreed_faces, pictures_without_a_face and blurred_spans. The copy is files.picture, kept under Made by tools; the original is never changed.
